full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen photograph showing an oral or jaw-related tissue mass containing a visible tooth. The specimen displays an irregular, fleshy, and somewhat ulcerative or proliferative lesion adjacent to the tooth root and surrounding bone structure. Such features are commonly evaluated in the context of odontogenic tumors, cysts, or localized malignancies of the jaw. The photograph documents the macroscopic appearance of the resected tissue block for diagnostic and archival purposes.
